SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint. The public endpoint rate-limits and commonly disables the WebSocket log subscriptions /alerts/stream needs; use a dedicated provider in production.

_notes.PORT: Not set here. Railway injects PORT and src/main.ts reads it (process.env.PORT || '3000'), so hardcoding it fights the platform.
_notes.CORS_ORIGIN: Deliberately unset. src/api/server.ts treats this as a comma-separated list of EXACT origins, not a wildcard — '*' matches no origin and silently blocks every browser. Set it in the Railway dashboard to your real dashboard origin(s) once one exists.
_notes.API_KEYS: Set this in the Railway dashboard before exposing the service publicly. src/main.ts warns on startup when NODE_ENV=production and it is unset; without it every route except /api/v1/health is open to anyone.
